title: Find the longest palindromic substring
answer: A practical O(n²) solution is expand-around-center. Treat every character as the center of an odd-length palindrome and every gap as the center of an even-length palindrome. Expand left and right while characters match, and keep the longest range found. AeroTopo's `longestPalindrome` method checks both parities for every center and returns the best substring. It uses O(1) extra working space aside from the returned String and is simpler than dynamic programming for this interview problem.
